surface_mechanism_description: The reaction steps involve ligand exchange between the cyclopentadienyl (Cp) ligands of the Mg precursor and surface hydroxyl groups, followed by water pulse to regenerate OH sites. The interaction of cyclopentadienyl-based Mg precursors with surface hydroxyl groups may involve ligand-exchange reactions with one or two OH groups.
evidence: The interaction of cyclopentadienyl-based Mg precursors with surface hydroxyl groups may involve the ligand-exchange reactions with one or two OH groups. ... the replacement of large (Cp) species by relatively small OH groups. ... the formation of Mg silicate.
